chunks: "Everything has a sanctity, and the sanctity of animals lies in their faces."

key_terms.شَيْءٍ: thing, indicating all entities in a general sense
key_terms.وُجُوهِهَا: their faces, the specially protected part mentioned here

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام teach about the sanctity of animals?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that every created thing has a sanctity that must be respected. In the case of animals, their faces possess a special inviolability, indicating the obligation to avoid harming or violating them there.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2472 - Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as)  said:
"Everything has a sanctity, and the sanctity of animals lies in their faces."
